plugins.description: Direct, prompt, plan and produce AI video on Higgsfield with Claude: ByteDance Seedance 2.5 / 2.0 and Cinema Studio clips, plus the keyframes, character references and image edits that feed them. Shot and acting direction, a prompt linter, free price checks before any spend, and full film planning: shot list, asset bible, a storyboard page to review and annotate, budget scenarios, approval gates and staged run scripts.
